about.title: About me
about.information: Software development student, passionate about continuous learning and improving my skills. I always seek to stay updated with new technologies and work in an organized, structured, and collaborative way. I maintain constant practice and study both academically and independently, developing a passion for web design, back-end development, and database management.
about.skill_information: I'm passionate about studying and I love languages. I have studied English and I'm currently continuing to learn it independently, constantly striving to improve in order to complement my skills in this field.
about.passion_information: My goal is to continue improving as a developer, strengthening my technical skills as well as my teamwork abilities, collaborating effectively and complementing them with artificial intelligence as a tool for work and study.
